posts.title: What I Learned as an SDE Intern at Amazon
posts.excerpt: Reflections on my summer internship at Amazon, working on email automation for Prime Video serving 100k+ users globally.

sections.text: This summer, I had the incredible opportunity to intern as a Software Development Engineer at Amazon's Prime Video team. It was an experience that challenged me, taught me, and ultimately shaped how I think about building software at scale.
I worked on email automation systems serving 100k+ Prime Video users globally. The scale was unlike anything I had worked on before.

items: Working at scale requires a different mindset
Code reviews are invaluable learning opportunities
Documentation is just as important as code
Always think about the customer impact

posts.title: Diving into Agentic AI: My Learning Journey
posts.excerpt: Exploring the fascinating world of AI agents, LLMs, and autonomous systems. Here's what I've been reading and building.

sections.text: The world of AI is evolving rapidly, and I've been particularly fascinated by the concept of agentic AI systems - AI that can autonomously plan, reason, and execute tasks.
Unlike traditional AI that responds to single prompts, agentic AI can break down complex goals, use tools, and iterate on solutions autonomously.

items: Reading research papers on AI reasoning
